appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'District Heating Demand Index'.
Y-axis ticks are labeled with demand index values: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2015.
Each data point is a black circular marker.
Each data point is labeled with its corresponding temperature value in °C.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the district heat demand dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
The comparison scope is the full-period district heat demand change from 2005 to 2015.
The routing decision must be one of: Route to substantial-change follow-up, Keep on routine monitoring, or Route to archive.
